subject.title: fix: pin mediated egress to public addresses

question: Should mediated egress become internet-only by default with no private-network opt-in in this PR?
rationale: The security fix tightens the documented egress boundary, but it can break existing trusted custom allowlists that use private/internal destinations, so maintainers need to own that boundary choice.

options.title: Approve internet-only default
options.body: Accept private/reserved destination blocking as the supported default after the range and fallback defects are fixed.

options.title: Add private opt-in
options.body: Keep public-only as the safe default but require an explicit flag, status wording, docs, and tests for trusted private-network egress.

options.title: Pause for egress policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide the permanent compatibility and security story for mediated egress.

recommendation.title: Approve internet-only default
recommendation.body: Accept private/reserved destination blocking as the supported default after the range and fallback defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced mediated egress and has the strongest current history signal for this feature boundary.
